policy: Containers that reserve more than `budget` pixels below their last child, as reported by XD3001. This list may only shrink. Adding an entry means a new over-reservation shipped; test/container-slack.test.ts fails on additions and on stale entries alike, and prints the corrected object.

known.cause: Every `group` in the tree over-reserves by 87 or 96 pixels. The synthetic `diagram` lane, which the compiler invents to hold loose top-level nodes, over-reserves by 168 to 203 when its children carry an explicit `at`. These are separate nested-group and explicit-position lane reservation defects.
